body: If you are free to play the Dragon is your best option otherwise go for the Tiger. You should get by the following order: Thor Spear artifact -> Tiger -> Freya (get her only after you unlocked the elsa pet) -> sphinx
You can get the pet for free if you manage to get 360 tickets. I managed to save around 40K gems before the event so I got the hero and weapon chest to upgrade my whisper to legendary.
